oracle.statement: GET cluster info of an existing collection returns HTTP 200 with a result object; a never-created or already-deleted collection name returns exactly HTTP 404 - a 2xx on an unknown name is Type1_IllegalSuccess (R1 200-on-unknown family regression probe), a non-404 4xx is wrong-disposition Type4, a 5xx with /healthz alive is Type3 (assertion qdrant_behavioral_cluster_collection_info_001)
